title: MAGENAIS Model Response
description: The normalized result envelope every MAGENAIS model returns. Mirrors the ModelResponse<T> TypeScript interface used internally by MAGENAIS (MASTER PROMPT V4.1 §13). "output" is intentionally left unconstrained here since its shape is model-specific.

output.description: Model-specific result payload. Shape is defined by each model's own documentation, not by this envelope.

confidence.description: Confidence in the result, where applicable. Should be omitted rather than guessed.

evidence.description: Supporting evidence for the result (e.g. which perturbations were tested). Model-specific shape.

explanation.description: Human-readable explanation of how the output was reached.

warnings.description: Caveats the caller/UI should surface, e.g. "small sample size".
